linux-ptl-audio-headers on Omarchy

The build-time headers for Arch's Panther Lake audio kernel, needed to compile out-of-tree kernel modules.

Package data synced 2026-10-17 · generated from the official Omarchy package repo

Short answer

To install linux-ptl-audio-headers on Omarchy, open a terminal and run omarchy pkg add linux-ptl-audio-headers. It is a 42.3 MB download (156.7 MB installed), version 6.19.9.arch1-1, licensed GPL-2.0-only. Headers and scripts for building modules for the Linux with Panther Lake SDCA audio backports kernel. Free and open source.

Install linux-ptl-audio-headers on Omarchy

This package ships the kernel headers and build scripts that pair with a specific Arch Linux kernel build carrying SDCA audio backports for Intel Panther Lake laptops. It contains no runtime software of its own; DKMS and other tools use it to compile kernel modules (like proprietary drivers) against that exact kernel version. It only matters if you are running that particular kernel and need to build a module for it.

  1. Open a terminal.
  2. Run the install command:
    omarchy pkg add linux-ptl-audio-headers
  3. Check it landed. Pacman should list version 6.19.9.arch1-1:
    pacman -Qi linux-ptl-audio-headers

Open and use linux-ptl-audio-headers

linux-ptl-audio-headers has no window of its own: it is a command-line tool, library or system component. To see the commands it added to your PATH:

pacman -Ql linux-ptl-audio-headers | grep /usr/bin/

linux-ptl-audio-headers requirements and compatibility

  • Only useful when running the matching linux-ptl-audio kernel package
  • Intel Panther Lake hardware for the audio fixes to be relevant

Dependencies Omarchy installs for you

  • pahole

Pricing and license

Free and open source. License: GPL-2.0-only.

Frequently asked questions

How do I install linux-ptl-audio-headers on Omarchy?

Open a terminal and run omarchy pkg add linux-ptl-audio-headers. The download is 42.3 MB and it takes 156.7 MB once installed. Omarchy pulls in any dependencies automatically.

Is linux-ptl-audio-headers free?

Free and open source. The package is licensed GPL-2.0-only.

How do I uninstall linux-ptl-audio-headers?

Run omarchy pkg drop linux-ptl-audio-headers. It removes the package from your system.

What does linux-ptl-audio-headers depend on?

The package declares 1 dependency: pahole. Omarchy installs them for you.

Is linux-ptl-audio-headers a desktop app?

No. linux-ptl-audio-headers has no window of its own; it is a command-line tool, library or system component.

Is linux-ptl-audio-headers in the official Omarchy repo?

Yes. It is published as linux-ptl-audio-headers (version 6.19.9.arch1-1) in the official Omarchy package repository. Arch Linux makes it. Project site: https://github.com/archlinux/linux.
